name: Marutham Thinner

name: Zebra Thinner
description: Zebra Thinner is a premium-quality paint thinner designed to deliver excellent performance and safety. Available in various can sizes of 4500ML, 2700ML, 1800ML, 900ML, and 450ML, Zebra Thinner is perfect for a range of applications, whether for professional or personal use. With its efficient formulation, Zebra Thinner effectively thins enamel, making it easier to apply and achieve a smooth, even finish. It is compatible with various paint types and works to clean brushes and surfaces, maintaining high-quality results without leaving residues.

name: Marudham NC Thinner
description: Marutham NC Thinner is a premium-quality, high-performance thinner specially formulated to deliver superior results when used with enamel and other nitrocellulose (NC) paints. Whether for industrial, commercial, or personal projects, Marutham NC Thinner is trusted for its efficiency, versatility, and quick-drying properties. Available in multiple convenient sizes — 4500ML, 2700ML, 1800ML, 900ML, and 450ML — Marutham NC Thinner is suitable for various needs and applications.

safety_precautions.title: Low Toxicity
safety_precautions.description: Unlike some traditional thinners that release harmful fumes or chemicals, Marutham NC Thinner is designed to minimize toxicity. This makes it a safer choice for indoor use and for workers who are exposed to thinners for prolonged periods

safety_precautions.title: Reduced Irritation
safety_precautions.description: The formulation of Marutham NC Thinner is optimized to reduce skin and eye irritation. When used according to instructions, it poses less risk of causing adverse reactions compared to other harsher thinners.

safety_precautions.title: Low Flammability
safety_precautions.description: While all thinners should be handled with caution, Marutham NC Thinner has a reduced flammability compared to some of the other high-risk alternatives, making it safer to store and use in your workspace.

safety_precautions.title: Stable Chemical Composition
safety_precautions.description: Marutham NC Thinner has a stable chemical composition that reduces the risks of reactions with other substances, which is common with other thinner products.

safety_precautions.title: Meets Safety Standards
safety_precautions.description: Manufactured under stringent safety guidelines, Marutham NC Thinner complies with various safety regulations, ensuring that users experience minimal risk while handling it.
